resource_noxite.name: Noxite
resource_noxite.description: A liquid that can be used as a fuel source.

resource_iron_ore.name: Iron Ore
resource_iron_ore.description: Unrefined metallic mineral used in industrial production. Smelted to produce iron, the base metal for machinery, structures, and tools.

resource_copper_ore.name: Copper Ore
resource_copper_ore.description: Unrefined mineral containing traces of copper. Processed through smelting to produce copper ingots for electrical and mechanical applications.

resource_iron_ingot.name: Iron Ingot
resource_iron_ingot.description: Refined from raw iron ore. A durable, versatile metal used in construction, machinery, and component fabrication.

resource_steel_round_bar.name: Steel Round Bar
resource_steel_round_bar.description: Alloyed and forged from iron and carbon into cylindrical form. Used in high-strength frameworks, shafts, hardware, and assemblies.

resource_copper_ingot.name: Copper Ingot
resource_copper_ingot.description: Refined from copper ore. A highly conductive metal used in wiring, electronics, and precision components.

resource_resinwood_log.name: Resinwood Log
resource_resinwood_log.description: A tough, fibrous log streaked with pale blue resin veins. Light yet strong, it's prized for building and crafting durable structures.
